mathematical_definition: A latent dimension 'j' is considered active if the empirical variance of its encoded means (mu) across a batch exceeds a specified threshold (tau). Formally, AU = sum_{j=1}^{d} I(Var(mu_{:, j}) > tau), where d is the latent space dimension, and I is the indicator function.
code_implementation_snippet:
with torch.no_grad():
    # Variance-based active unit tracking
    au = int((mu.var(dim=0) > 1e-2).sum().item())
evaluation_context: Computed dynamically on the training set (per-batch) within the main training loop in `training/train_vae.py` to monitor latent space collapse in real-time.
